sources.title: Copycat launches of a ticker (new Solana mints named like it)
sources.sourceName: Helius DAS searchAssets (key) · keyless fallback: DexScreener token search + GeckoTerminal pool search
sources.cadence: continuous; one reading per complete UTC day

admission.note: ANTI-GAMING, mandatory: a mint costs ~0.002 SOL, so a bare copycat is not an event. A copycat counts only with >= $1,000 of pool liquidity or >= 25 distinct traders at the reading; one unit per creator wallet per day (the mint's first-transaction fee payer, read from RPC); at most 10 units a day; our own mint excluded; Solana only. The cheapest way to force one unit is therefore to lock >= $1,000 in a pool under a fresh wallet, and ten of them cap the day — the pool pays 1 - 0.95^10 = 40% at most, and the attacker's $10,000 of liquidity is what the coin's traders then trade against.

unit.label: 1 copycat
unit.definition: per UTC day: each NEW Solana mint whose metadata symbol matches ^$?DEFICIT$ or whose name contains DEFICIT, created that day, with >= $1,000 of pool liquidity or >= 25 distinct traders at the reading; one per creator wallet; at most 10 per day

sources.memoSource: helius das searchAssets | dexscreener search + geckoterminal search/pools
flags: indexer-dependent: tier 4 with a Helius key, tier 5 on the keyless fallback (pool-visible copycats only)
unverified: the keyed path has not been run on this host; 14 logged days before any rule launches on it
creator from RPC getSignaturesForAddress (oldest) + getTransaction fee payer
sources.note: second demo coin candidate (docs/launch/copycat-coin.md); not launchable until a keyed run logs 14 days and the admission rules are checked against them
